g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Keep all social-media account credentials and 2FA backup codes recorded in a digital vault
on my phone so that account details are not lost. → Ensure that only I can access my soci
al-media accounts through strong authentication, such as a 2FA backup code required when s
igning in from a new device.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Be shown a varied assortment of content rather than the same kind of content repeated. → S
tay informed about news and trends around the world, including what is happening back in I
ndia, with Twitter as my go-to news app.
